title: Add a test that `idefactory init` exits 0 and leaves an existing consumer workflow byte-for-byte unchanged, that `idefactory upgrade` still does not create a missing workflow, and that `idefactory ci scaffold` still exits non-zero and leaves existing bytes unchanged. Then keep that exists-path on the write-if-absent helper so init does not use the throwing scaffold command. Verify with `node --test test/consumer-ci-scaffold.test.mjs`. The exists and upgrade assertions pass on current main; they must still pass after task 1.1.
acceptanceCriteria: Init keeps an existing workflow, upgrade does not write one, and ci scaffold still refuses to overwrite.
